title: Autopilot engine config (engine + project)
description: Project-agnostic schema for the target two-section config shape: a neutral `engine` block (models, CLI, cadence, routing, budget) and a swappable `project` block (workspace paths, validation commands, goals, git targets, context pointer). The engine reads only `engine.*` plus the ContextProvider derived from `project.*`; it never hard-codes a host project's facts. Point your config.json at this file via `"$schema": "core/config.schema.json"` for IDE validation and autocomplete. Legacy flat-key configs (top-level `models`, `cli`, `validation`, `git`, ...) are still accepted by core/config.mjs `loadConfig()`, which remaps them into this shape with a deprecation warning.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file so editors validate the config.

engine.description: PROJECT-NEUTRAL engine tuning. Contains nothing about any specific host project.

models.description: Model id per agent role. Values are provider-resolved model ids (or logical tiers).

selector.description: Model for the SELECT role (task ranking).

reviewer.description: Model for the REVIEW role (adversarial quality gate).

auditor.description: Model for the AUDIT role (regression/scope check).

implementerRouting.description: Risk-aware model routing for the implementer.

opusMinRisk.description: Risk level at/above which the strong tier is forced.

opusKeywords.description: Title/goal keywords that force the strong tier regardless of risk.

permission.description: Permission flag passed to the CLI.

maxTurnsPerCall.description: Max agent turns per CLI call.

maxReviseAttempts.description: Max revise loops before a task is blocked.

backlogTopUpThreshold.description: Backlog size below which the selector tops up.

baseCooldownMs.description: Base cooldown after a rate-limit hit.

resetAt.description: ISO timestamp of the next budget-window reset.

jaccardThreshold.description: Similarity cutoff for matching past failures.

project.description: SWAPPABLE host-project profile. All project-specific facts live here, never in the engine.

id.description: Stable project id (also used as a context cache key).

workspaceRoot.description: Path the agent may edit — the target repo, relative to the autopilot/ parent or absolute.

integrationBranch.description: Branch all reviewed work lands on.

validation.description: Validation hooks — dynamic command arrays run after each implementation.

commands.description: Ordered validation commands. A failing `required` command fails the cycle.

required.description: If true, failure blocks the cycle.

lintRegressionGuard.description: Fail the cycle if the lint-error count increases.

goals.description: Ordered goal phases the selector cycles through (project-defined).

scoring.description: Task scoring weights and selection thresholds.

context.description: Pointer to the ContextProvider that maps this workspace into the agents.

provider.description: Provider kind. "fs" reads a contexts/<id>/ directory; future: "git", "remote".

domainKnowledgeDir.description: Directory holding profile.json / seed-backlog.json / domain.md / prompts/ for this project.
